_comment: Who is home for what, who covers it, and on what terms. Read identically by
every node; validated by `pmt-fleet map` before anything acts on it.
Safety does NOT rest on both boxes holding the same copy of this file. There is
exactly one lease item per series and it names exactly one holder, so a diverged
map costs a refused acquire and a confusing log line, never a self-match. See
PHASE 1 DOES NOT READ THIS TO TRADE. The heartbeat daemon uses it only to know
which node it is and what to print. Nothing acquires a lease yet.
_leases_active: FALSE through phase 1: the table holds heartbeats and no lease items, and the
engines run on their static PMENGINE_SERIES_ALLOWLIST exactly as they do today.
Flip to true at rollout step 6 (DESIGN.md §8.3), when the claim daemon starts
taking real leases. Until then the checker treats series rows as informational.
Explicit rather than inferred from 'there are no lease items': inferring it would
read a catastrophically emptied table as a quiet phase-1 fleet and suppress the
one alarm that would have caught it (failure matrix row 17).

desktop.label: Bazzite desktop (hunter)
desktop._note: Powers off nightly on purpose. Its SIGTERM path is the designed-for handover: release the lease, hand over instantly, never page.

euw.label: eu-west-1 t4g.micro (pmt-eu-ssm)
euw._doctor_active: false until the pmt-fleet-doctor IAM policy is approved and attached to pmt-eu-ssm. A node that has not been brought up is not a dark node, and paging about it every cadence until then trains the wrong reflex. Flip to true at rollout step 2.
euw._note: PMENGINE_MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE=60 against ~182 pUSD. It can meaningfully cover TWO of the desktop's series at these template sizes, not eight — hence failover_priority. Covering more would mean arms that cannot fill.

arm_template._note: The desktop has capital to spare but no tuning history on bnb. Conservative because it is covering, not competing.

hype-updown-5m._note: No failover: pilot2's live default names hype, and a covering engine on a series the pilot may also trade is a third participant on one book.

btc-updown-15m._note: grace 1200s = one 15m window (900) + fence check + stop latency + pair skew, rounded up. A 15m holder may only be able to stop at a window boundary.
